text: Eating well is one part of healthy living, but a truly balanced approach includes exercise, sleep, and mental health. A balanced diet gives you energy, while regular exercise strengthens your body and clears your mind. Don't forget rest; your brain and muscles need sleep to recover. Mental health is just as important as physical health, so find time to relax and manage stress. This is where work-life balance matters. If you spend all your hours working or studying, stress builds up quickly. Instead, schedule breaks, walks, or hobbies. Small, consistent habits—a short daily workout, a set bedtime, or a weekly chat with friends—make healthy living realistic and sustainable over time.
